draft_text: Wrenfold's advantage over Fennick-Base may extend to customer-service domains not seen in training.
revised_text: Wrenfold's advantage over Fennick-Base extends to customer-service domains not seen in training, with higher macro-F1 on all three held-out domains (Insurance 85.7 vs 81.2, Telecom 83.9 vs 80.4, Utilities 86.2 vs 82.0).
rationale: T1.r3–r5 show Wrenfold higher than Fennick-Base on all three held-out domains. The sentence hedges with "may extend," but the evidence supports a stronger, direct claim of extension. No statistical test is reported, so significance language is avoided; the claim is about the observed advantage extending.
